summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K to report its monthly net asset value (NAV) as of May 31, 2026. The filing discloses the NAV per share for seven share classes, ranging from $24.8719 to $26.0649, and a breakdown of total NAV components totaling approximately $1.336 billion. This is a routine monthly NAV update required for a non-traded REIT to set its transaction and repurchase price. No special-situation event — such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change — is announced. This periodic disclosure is ordinary and does not trigger a special-situations classification.
